`cd /var/folders/vj/tkmrz5cj4yz56zrtvb8lvc540000gn/T/tak-inspect-mcp-9_1q8fl0 && /Users/wadechandler/.asdf/installs/python/3.13.5/bin/python -c "
import json
import subprocess
import sys

# Start the MCP server
proc = subprocess.Popen(
    ['/Users/wadechandler/.asdf/installs/python/3.13.5/bin/python', '/Users/wadechandler/Projects/wadechandler/github/terminal-agent-kit/scripts/agent_inspection/mock_mcp_echo.py'],
    stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE
)

def send(msg):
    body = json.dumps(msg).encode('utf-8')
    proc.stdin.write(('Content-Length: %d\r\n\r\n' % len(body)).encode() + body)
    proc.stdin.flush()

def read():
    line = proc.stdout.readline().decode()
    if not line.startswith('Content-Length:'):
        return None
    n = int(line.split(':', 1)[1].strip())
    proc.stdout.readline()  # blank
    return json.loads(proc.stdout.read(n).decode())

# Initialize
send({'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'id': 1, 'method': 'initialize', 'params': {'protocolVersion': '2024-11-05', 'capabilities': {}, 'clientInfo': {'name': 'test', 'version': '0.1.0'}}})
read()
send({'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'method': 'notifications/initialized'})
# Call echo tool
send({'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'id': 2, 'method': 'tools/call', 'params': {'name': 'echo', 'arguments': {'text': 'hello from tak'}}})
resp = read()
proc.terminate()
proc.wait(timeout=2)
# Show result
if resp and 'result' in resp:
    content = resp['result'].get('content', [])
    for block in content:
        if block.get('type') == 'text':
            print(block.get('text', ''))
else:
    print(resp, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
"`
